blocks.text: Zarraat ki tarteeb ke tareeqe ki bunyad par solids ki do qismein hain: crystalline solids aur amorphous solids.

blocks.caption: Crystalline aur amorphous solids ka muqabla (Table 5.5)
rows: Apne melting points par tez pighalte hain
Koi sharp melting point nahi; darja hararat ki had mein pighalte hain
Anisotropic: khusoosiyat paimaish ki simt par munhasir
Isotropic: khusoosiyat simt par munhasir nahi

blocks.alt: Zarraat ke teen dabbe: crystalline solid ke liye jamni nuqton ki sath-ri jaali, amorphous solid ke liye narangi nuqton ka dher jis mein ek chhota ba-tarteeb hissa crystallite nishan-zada hai, aur liquid crystal ke liye sabz chhariyan taqreeban mutawazi leti hui, har ek notes ke saath. Neeche solid se liquid se gas ki zanjeer, teeron par molar heats of fusion aur vaporization ke saath.
blocks.caption: Crystalline solids, amorphous solids aur liquid crystals, phase tabdeeliyon ki energetics ke saath (Table 5.5 aur topics 5.10 aur 5.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Crystalline solid apni tarteeb lambe faslon tak dohrata hai, jo makhsoos shaklein, sharp melting points, cleavage planes aur simt par munhasir khusoosiyat deta hai. Amorphous solid mein sirf chhote ba-tarteeb hisse hain, to woh had mein pighalta hai, us ki koi muqarrar heat of fusion nahi, use dhaala ja sakta hai aur woh har simt mein ek jaisa hai. Liquid crystal mein chhari-numa molecules behte hue taqreeban mutawazi rehte hain, to woh liquid ka behna aur viscosity crystal ki optical khusoosiyat aur anisotropy ke saath milata hai. Pighalna aur bukharat banna molar heats of fusion aur vaporization jazb karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Glass ko kabhi kabhi asli solid ke bajaye supercooled liquid kaha jata hai. Table ki kaun si qatarein is bayan ki hemayat karti hain?
blocks.explanation: Glass amorphous hai: us mein long-range order nahi, sharp melting point nahi (darja hararat ki had mein naram hota hai) aur woh isotropic hai, us liquid ki tarah jis ke molecules bas harkat band kar chuke hon. Asli crystalline solid long-range order, sharp melting point aur anisotropy dikhata.

items: Tarteeb se do qismein: crystalline (makhsoos shakal, sharp melting point, anisotropic, long-range order) aur amorphous (dhele ya powder, had mein pighalta, isotropic, long-range order nahi).
